content.text:
I submitted **index 4 (Ag 0.54 / Sb 0.46)** as the best composition, with an EQE of 0.372%. That's the highest of the three samples I measured. I don't know how it compares to the library's true best.

| Index | Ag fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 0.54 | **0.372** |
| 5 | 0.50 | 0.369 |
| 9 | 0.36 | 0.161 |

- **Why I started at 1:1:** the known phase AgSbO3 sits there. The MACE model (a machine-learned potential that estimates stability) predicts it is stable, and MEGNet (a machine-learned band-gap predictor) gives a gap of about 1.8 eV, low enough to absorb the 2.7 eV light.
- **Sb-rich side:** EQE fell to less than half at index 9, so the Sb-rich end looks worse.
- **Ag-rich side:** Ag3SbO4 is predicted to have almost no band gap (about 0.09 eV), so I didn't measure the far Ag-rich samples. Ag7Sb9O25, near index 7, is also predicted to have a small gap (0.43 eV). Both are model predictions only; I never measured those compositions.

**Uncertainties:**
- Indices 4 and 5 differ by only 0.003 percentage points, so the peak could lie anywhere around the 1:1 composition. Indices 3 and 6 were never measured.
- I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so I haven't confirmed which crystal phases the films actually contain.
- The merit budget is spent, so I couldn't check whether the EQE peak lies between these points.
